$description: Fresh Orbit illustration slots (D53). Every image the apps show fills one slot. Edit scene, alt, characters or style here, then run `pnpm --filter @fresh/illustrations prompts` to rebuild the prompts and `pnpm --filter @fresh/illustrations validate`. To use final images: put them in docs/design/characters/generated/<slot_in_lower_snake_case>.jpg (or .png when transparent) and run `pnpm --filter @fresh/illustrations run import`. See README.md.
stylePrompt: Highly detailed, realistic 3D animated-film style character render, soft subsurface skin, natural hair strands and fabric texture, expressive friendly faces, warm cinematic studio lighting with soft shadows, shallow depth of field, clean modern look, warm sand-coloured background (#FBF4E8) unless stated, brand colours sea teal (#0B7D70) and coral (#F07A5A) as accents, set in coastal Andhra Pradesh, India.
promptSuffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. High resolution.

backgrounds.SAND: Background: the warm sand-coloured backdrop with a soft floor shadow and no busy scenery
backgrounds.TRANSPARENT: Background: transparent (or, if transparency is not available, a plain flat white background), the subject isolated with nothing around it so it can be cut out cleanly
backgrounds.SCENE: Background: a full, softly lit scene that fits the moment (the harbour at sunrise, the fish market, a home kitchen or a city street), slightly out of focus behind the characters, with no signs or writing anywhere

aspects.1:1: Square 1:1 image, subject centred, full body or three-quarter view
aspects.4:3: Landscape 4:3 image, subject slightly off centre with room on one side
aspects.2:1: Wide 2:1 banner image, the subjects spread across the whole width, seen from slightly above
aspects.3:2: Wide 3:2 image, the subject on the right half with the left third kept empty

FISHMONGER.name: Padma
FISHMONGER.description: An Indian woman, about 30, warm brown skin, a small dark bindi and a bright friendly smile; a coral headscarf over a low black bun; a white short-sleeve kurta under a glossy sea-teal fishmonger apron, with a coral skirt hem showing below it; light-blue rubber gloves; dark-green rubber boots; she often holds a fresh silver fish; same face, headscarf and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

RIDER.name: Ravi
RIDER.description: A man, about 26, with a short beard and moustache and a cheerful smile; a sea-teal helmet with a clear visor; a teal rain jacket with silver reflective stripes; an ice-blue insulated backpack with a white snowflake mark; dark cargo trousers and white sneakers; rides a coral-orange electric scooter; same face and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

SUPPORT_AGENT.name: Anil
SUPPORT_AGENT.description: A man, about 32, with wavy black hair and round thin glasses, calm and kind; a teal polo shirt, navy trousers with a brown belt and white sneakers; a slim black headset with a small microphone; same face, hair and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

HOME_COOK.name: Ammamma
HOME_COOK.description: A grandmother, about 65, with silver hair in a bun, a red bindi and a warm knowing smile; a mango-yellow saree with a coral border over a coral blouse, gold bangles and a thin gold necklace; she carries a steel pot and a ladle; same face, hair and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

POMFRET.name: Chanduva
POMFRET.description: A round silver pomfret fish with big glossy eyes, rosy cheeks and an open happy smile, using its fins as hands; a friendly character, never food; same look as in the approved character sheet in every picture
